title: Hubble Illuminates Cluster of Diverse Galaxies
caption: Galaxy ESO 325-G004 and the cluster Abell S0740, imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: ESO 325-G004, Abell S0740 · constellation Centaurus · about 463 million light-years away (source figure)
credit: NASA, ESA, and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA); Acknowledgment: J. Blakeslee (Washington State University)

recognition.text: NASA Hubble image release (STScI). No published audience rating.

story: The giant elliptical galaxy ESO 325-G004 looms at the centre of a mixed crowd of galaxies. They belong to the cluster Abell S0740, more than 450 million light-years away toward the constellation Centaurus, and ESO 325-G004 alone is as massive as 100 billion suns.

The galaxy's diffuse halo is sprinkled with thousands of faint pinpoints. Each is a globular star cluster, a compact group of hundreds of thousands of stars held together by gravity, orbiting the giant galaxy. Even at this great distance, Hubble resolves them as separate points of light.

Other fuzzy elliptical galaxies are scattered across the frame, and a few have hints of a disc or ring that lends them a bow-tie outline. Several spiral galaxies appear as well. In these, most of the starlight sits in a flat disc and follows the spiral arms, unlike the fuzzy ellipticals.

understand.summary: A composite of many exposures from Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys. F475W is shown in blue, F625W in green and F814W in red.
understand.eye: The F814W filter records near-infrared light the eye cannot see, and the colours are assigned to three separate filter images.

behind.people: See full credit: NASA, ESA, and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA); Acknowledgment: J. Blakeslee (Washington State University)
behind.exposure: Observation dates per NASA: January 2005 - February 2006.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: Science data that Hubble gathered in January 2005 were merged with Hubble Heritage observations made a year later. Filters isolating blue, red and infrared light were used with the Advanced Camera for Surveys to build the three-colour composite.
sources: NASA release: Hubble Illuminates Cluster of Diverse Galaxies
alt: A large, glowing elliptical galaxy at centre surrounded by many smaller elliptical and spiral galaxies.
